scope: Broaden open-source comparison to downstream application loss inventories, user-reported AutoCAD round-trip outcomes, DXF INSUNITS presence/default handling, reader lineage, and the limits of visible 3D tessellation; refine existing plan gates only.

method.sourcePinning: GitHub default-branch documentation and issue pages are mutable. The reviewed AutoCAD report is a user contribution, not an independently reproduced run; future comparator execution must pin the application build, source revision, exact inputs and expected output version.
method.evidenceRule: Peer loss reports identify failure modes and test vectors, not libdxfrw defects. Separate requested/actual file version, open result, audit/repair outcomes, semantic object/owner inventory, visual result, parser lineage, and geometric-kernel evidence.

evidence.topic: CADCraft downstream loss inventory and parser lineage
evidence.observed: CADCraft documents ACadRust as its DWG read/write backend. Its gap inventory was reviewed 2026-10-10 and says its 36 file tests were synthetic with no AutoCAD check at that time; it lists remaining DWG-path losses including custom-class entities/objects, table/block XDATA, color-book names and reactors.
doesNotEstablish: a libdxfrw defect or matching loss
an independent DWG parser lineage from ACadRust
current CADCraft behavior after later code or reports
complete DWG round-trip semantics
evidence.planUse: Use the loss list to select object/graph routes and reconcile it with newer dated evidence. Classify CADCraft and ACadRust as one DWG parser family. Do not count app and library results as independent parser votes.

evidence.topic: User-reported AutoCAD 2027 acceptance has multiple independent outcomes
evidence.observed: An issue opened 2026-10-11 reports a Windows 11 / AutoCAD 2027 round trip: AutoCAD-origin AC1032 input was saved by CADCraft as AC1018; the output reopened and looked visually correct, but AutoCAD AUDIT reported six errors, including AcDbTableStyle(1109) - not fixed, with zero repairs and zero erased objects. The issue remained open at review. This post-dates the CADCraft gap inventory's 2026-10-10 review date.
doesNotEstablish: independent reproduction of the user report
a maintainer-run AutoCAD regression suite
a libdxfrw output defect
clean output merely because the file opens or looks correct
evidence.planUse: For the existing composed native gate, record requested and actual output code, native open, AUDIT errors/fixes/erasures/messages, source-handle and owner disposition, and visual/geometry outcome as separate fields. Files offered by the reporter were not fetched or retained.

evidence.topic: Legacy DXF absent INSUNITS may inherit a peer application's document template
evidence.observed: CADCraft issue #1209, opened 2026-10-14, reports that CLI 0.6.2 on Linux ARM64 rewrote 17 public R2.6-R14 DXFs with no $INSUNITS as $INSUNITS=1. The maintainer attributes the behavior to starting an import from an imperial new-drawing template and proposes making absent input unitless; that fix is not verified here. Autodesk documents explicit INSUNITS=0 as unspecified/no units, with initial values 1 (imperial) or 4 (metric).
doesNotEstablish: that omitted $INSUNITS is equivalent to explicit zero for every producer/version
a libdxfrw defect
$INSUNITS being normative input to $MEASUREMENT
any required coordinate rescaling
evidence.planUse: Refine existing 7BJ.4/header test family with locally authored absent, explicit 0, 1 and 4 DXF controls in legacy and one modern profile. Preserve the omission-vs-value distinction until a producer/version contract resolves the omitted case; test header read/write and unchanged geometry without deriving $MEASUREMENT from $INSUNITS. Do not copy third-party issue samples.

evidence.observed: dwg-rs reports per-version decoded/skipped/errored counts for 19 sample drawings (3,911 decoded, 525 skipped, 9 errored), with the measurement dated 2026-08-30; its documentation says new boundary checks exposed several record failures. uncad documents DWG input through LibreDWG FFI, DXF input through the separate undxf crate, and removal of its DWG/DXF write API.
doesNotEstablish: production completeness from dwg-rs aggregate decode rates
an independent DWG decoder lineage for uncad
writer acceptance from uncad
a directly comparable corpus or per-family denominator
evidence.planUse: If dwg-rs is used in a composed comparison, pin its revision and overlapping inputs and report per-version/per-family decoded, skipped, errored, and boundary-checked denominators. Treat uncad's DWG path as LibreDWG lineage; consider only its undxf route for an optional DXF-specific projection. Add no required Rust toolchain or dependency.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio visual tessellation is not complete-body evidence
evidence.observed: The application documentation separates ACIS body lift into its early B-rep kernel from per-surface tessellation fallback and says a mesh is marked incomplete when all faces do not lift. The kernel describes itself as early and says most operations remain unwritten.
doesNotEstablish: complete ACIS body reconstruction from visible display
an independent DWG/DXF parser from the ACadRust/opencadcodec lineage
exact topology, dimensions, volume, or history semantics
support outside a separately executed profile
evidence.planUse: Keep it an optional, exact-revision visible-disposition probe. Any narrow analytic witness requires full-face lift, no fallback/incomplete state, and independently specified shape invariants; a rendered/partially sampled body is not a pass.

implementationReadinessChanges: Refine 7BJ.4 with source-generated DXF cases for absent $INSUNITS and explicit 0/1/4, in legacy and one modern profile; preserve variable presence/value policy and unchanged coordinates.
Keep absent $INSUNITS distinct from explicit unitless 0 until producer/version evidence resolves omission semantics; never derive $MEASUREMENT or coordinate scaling from the peer report.

At the existing composed native checkpoint, report expected/actual code, open, audit errors/fixes/erasures, object/owner outcomes and visual/geometry separately; pin exact application/build and input/output hashes.
Refresh parser lineage: CADCraft/OpenCADStudio share the ACadRust family; uncad uses LibreDWG for DWG; dwg-rs remains optional/pre-alpha with a small, dated self-reported corpus.
Retain affected-fast-test per slice, one composed external/native batch, and scheduled full-suite/fuzz validation; no mandatory peer install or new fixture is added.
